rule: These are the authority. Everything built for MARS is judged against them, and a build that disagrees with a reference is wrong even when its numbers are green. Measured values extracted from MARS_CANONICAL_LOOK live in look_measured.json.

images.name: MARS_CANONICAL_LOOK
images.what: THE look. Deep cobalt face, violet dreadlocks, glowing cyan-white forehead sigil, solid luminous white eyes with NO socket or rim, on PURE BLACK with multi-coloured four-point sparkle stars.

images.name: SIGIL_ARTWORK
images.what: The Mars sigil as drawn: violet ringed triangle, orange Mars glyph, green eye, pink spiral, yellow molecule, teal edges.
images.governs: the forehead sigil's colours and line weights

images.name: SIGIL_KEYED_TRANSPARENT
images.what: The same sigil keyed to transparency, ready as a decal.

images.name: SIGIL_ON_FOREHEAD_CORRECT
images.what: Sigil seated ON the forehead, neon, over a soft bokeh field.

images.name: SIGIL_MISPLACED_FLOATING
images.what: REJECTED: the decal floating beside the head instead of lying on the brow. Kept as the failure case.
images.governs: what a raycast decal looks like when it misses

images.name: ANIMATIC_SQUARES_REJECTED
images.what: REJECTED: hard square sprites instead of stars/nebula. The 'squares' problem.

images.name: ANIMATIC_SQUARES_WIDE
images.what: REJECTED: same squares, wide, with a wireframe icosahedron.
images.governs: the geometric transition beat, wrong star treatment

images.name: ANIMATIC_PARTICLE_BAND
images.what: Dense particle band across squares -- closer to stars, still square-backed.
images.governs: density reference for the world-creation beat

images.name: ANIMATIC_HEAD_ON_BLACK_3Q
images.what: Mars three-quarter on a clean black starfield. Closest to canon of the animatic frames.
images.governs: camera and lighting for the opening

images.name: ANIMATIC_HEAD_ON_BLACK_FRONT
images.what: Mars front on black with the sculpted brow sigil.

images.name: COCKPIT_LOGIN
images.what: God Molecule control plane operator login.

images.name: COCKPIT_STARFIELD_BLOCKED
images.what: Cockpit with a run in BLOCKED / NO_BLENDER_WORKER_CONNECTED and QC_PENDING -- honest states, never a fabricated PASS.
images.governs: how the cockpit must report an un-run job

images.name: COCKPIT_NO_RUN_DISPATCHED
images.what: Cockpit resting state: NO RUN DISPATCHED, empty run ledger.

images.name: MOUTH_BLOCKY_TEETH_REJECTED
images.what: REJECTED: procedural blocky crowns, the 'mouthguard' arch.
images.governs: why the GNM donor replaced procedural teeth

images.name: MOUTH_GNM_DONOR
images.what: GNM scan-derived teeth, gums and tongue in place.

images.name: MOUTH_WIDE_CURRENT
images.what: The WIDE pose as rendered in this session.

images.name: SESSION_REST_FRAME
images.what: REST after the inverted-cutter fix, as reviewed on device.
images.governs: the closed-mouth reference for this build
